ok so i know this review is really long but damnit i will wright a good and accurate review.
     description of game:
Risk of rain is a one man 2D run&gun game, where you pick a character who's ship got hijacked by evilmcbaddude Providince. You crash land on a "desolate" planet, shooting the faces off various enemies. Killing enemies gives exp and gold which is automatically collected after a few seconds. Gain enough exp to level up, and your abilities will be upgraded and your character will get more health. Use gold to unlock chests that will give you items that will aid in your quest to kill evilmcbaddude Providince. Once you've done everything in one area, you go to the teleporter, which is so interesting looking you won't be able to miss it. Activate the teleporter and you will get a 90 second bum rush of enemies. a boss or 2 are thrown in too. (The time the bum rush takes is dependant on game difficulty). Once the bum rush is over, you can teleport to the next area. Rinse and repeat until evilmcbaddude Providince is dead. Every 15 minutes, you can hear a bell in the background, this means that the difficulty rises. Enemies get tougher, and can be variant. (they get buff) This difficulty meter maxes out when you've played for around 90 minutes, where the difficulty will be set to HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA and by now you probably have enough items where its no biggie. Alot of stages will have a secret area where a relic can be found. These are basically hax. These include but are not limited to: Glass-deal 5x more damage, but have 1/10 health. Command- Pick the items you get from chests. Spirit-Everything runs sanic fast when almost dead. and much more.
     pros:
High speed combat with many sprites on screen at a single time
even a smaller computer can run it
gameplay is challenging
graphics are interesting
you unlock your hax
Levels are randomly generated, adhering to a strict set of guidlines
     cons
sometimes runs slowly (not often)
only 3 varieties of zoom, 2 are too much, one is too little
game is incredibly easy late game
     reasons not to spend 10 bucks on this game
If you arent a casual game player, this game will be rediculously easy, even on maximum settings.
unlocking all the characters is quite a chore, same with all the items and relics

I know there is online functionality, but i dont have any friends to play this with :( so i cant say how good multiplayer feels. This game has many hours of content available to it, and is well worth the 10 bucks it costs. Ive been playing it for over two years now, and i still enjoy it quite well. Although i didnt play it often, it is a good time killer.
